mission: Prove one Gravity Fist combat semantic across the Vanguard representation boundary: one standard-attack request made during an active attack is buffered, does not start early, and starts the next chain move at the current move's semantic attack_end even when the current visual recipe still has recovery frames.

evidence: lines 1296-1337: a right-side tap sets buffered_attack
lines 1339-1365: _do_attack selects and advances the ordered standard chain
lines 1431-1469: buffered attack fires only when no attack and no combo recovery are active
lines 1471-1523: attack_end closes the current attack

semanticInvariant.name: buffered-standard-chain-cutover
semanticInvariant.executable: During an active standard attack, retain at most one next-standard-attack request. Do not start it before semantic attack_end. On the first eligible update that reaches or passes attack_end, if no blocking recovery exists, consume the request exactly once and start the next ordered standard move.

targetBoundary.authorityRule: The adapter owns combat cutover. Recipes remain presentation data and are read-only proof fixtures.

lockedSurface: all accepted or quarantined animation assets
requiredEvidence: donor revision and source hash match
buffer does not start the next move before 320 ms
the next move starts exactly at 320 ms
changing presentation recovery duration does not change semantic cutover

humanReview.reason: This proof is limited to deterministic state-transition parity. Animation quality and combat feel are explicitly outside the claim.

proofResult.claimBoundary: State-transition parity only. No claim is made about animation quality, combat feel, hit timing, damage, deployment, or broad target integration.
